claims.claim: Documented the REPAIR/REMEDIATION delivery matrix, authorization boundaries, executorless paths, replay behavior and operational receipt limits.
Added exact-subject Human AUTO authorization and protected failed-RUN profile reuse, with rejection of missing proof, invalid source profiles and unsupported Bot coding dispatch.
Preserved explicit manual profile selection and added exact Human Issue provenance checks; mixed AUTO/manual profile inputs are rejected.
AUTO consumes canonical executor_required and leaves eligible executorless repairs profileless without resolving a coding profile.
Extended the existing immutable journal with AUTO actor, source RUN and profile digest bindings; replay reuses the bound profile and rejects identity or AUTO/manual conflicts.
Added bounded AUTO authorization/profile rejection receipts and distinguished downstream operational failure from carrier rejection without asserting RUN success.
Added focused regression cases for Human AUTO, manual selection, forged proof, invalid profiles, executorless branches, replay conflicts and bounded rejection receipts.
